title: Point to point dinner run, rapid fire
persona: Tasha Reynolds, upbeat young professional, talks quickly, slangy.
goal: Book a point-to-point ride for a dinner with all details given up front.
opening_line: Hey! Need a black car tomorrow night, 7:30, pick up 123 Main Street Milwaukee, go to the Pfister Hotel, four of us, no bags, SUV, Tasha Reynolds, 414-555-0122.

turns.caller: Yep, four people. Me and three friends.

branches.caller: Tomorrow. Like, tomorrow night. Whatever tomorrow is.

turns.caller: SUV is good. Something nice, it's a birthday.
Oh, and can the driver wait a few min if we're late coming out?

branches.if_agent: agent promises a specific wait policy or fee

turns.caller: Cell is 414-555-0122. Same as I said.
Cool, is that all booked now?

branches.if_agent: agent says it is sent to dispatch for confirmation
branches.caller: Okay, so I'll hear back from them? Got it.

curveballs: Asks if it is fully booked
expected: Handles relative date by confirming or clarifying the actual date
Captures pickup, drop-off, time, passengers, vehicle, name and cell without repeating questions
Explains that the request goes to dispatch for confirmation
Does not quote prices or fees
must_not: Quote a rate or wait fee
Claim the ride is guaranteed before dispatch confirms
Ask for information the caller already gave
